title: Add figure provenance to the book build and settle the figure import mechanism
acceptance_criteria: A figure manifest records, for each included figure, the canonical source path and revision, the renderer digest, the output hash and the embedded bytes
The book source-tree hash covers figure sources and embedded assets, so a changed source cannot leave the manifest unchanged
book/build.sh fails when a referenced figure is missing or its rendered asset is stale relative to its source

The two-variant pilot is executed and recorded: direct repo-root import versus a generated book/assets export, compared on editor-preview portability, clean-tree build and manifest coverage; the chosen mechanism is documented in book/FIGURES.md
The mutation test passes: editing a .puml without regenerating its SVG fails the build
validation: Run the mutation test and show the build failing
HIGH review confirms the manifest covers source, renderer and embedded bytes for every figure
